statement: In Linux v7.3-rc1 hid-steam, the wired IBEX sensor evdev node is named Steam Controller Motion Sensors and copies bustype, vendor, product and version from the HID device; the USB consumer identity therefore carries BUS_USB and vendor/product 0x28de:0x1302, with version inherited rather than fixed here (hid-steam.c:1163-1200). The node sets INPUT_PROP_ACCELEROMETER and advertises EV_MSC/MSC_TIMESTAMP (hid-steam.c:1201-1203). ABS_X/Y/Z accelerometer axes are [-32768,32768], fuzz 128, flat 0, resolution 16384; ABS_RX/RY/RZ gyro axes are [-32768,32768], fuzz 0, flat 0, resolution 16 (hid-steam.c:70-78,1211-1230). This is pinned kernel consumer shape, not an observed device event stream.

applicability.revision: Linux v7.3-rc1 source at cee9395acd8043be0644b25c34bfa86623f2b935; physical revision not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only for direct wired USB 28de:1302 motion-sensor evdev capability registration. Does not assert that a host created or received events from a device.
